estimator_selection.selection_rule: lowest mean QLIKE on VALIDATION, averaged over instruments and horizons; declared before running and independent of the calibration gate

specification_iteration.first_specification: log RV_t -> log RV_t+1 using close-to-close daily variance
specification_iteration.first_result: FAILED on GLD (t=1.81) and SCHD (t=2.84) of 9
specification_iteration.why_respecified: a single squared close-to-close return is an unbiased but extremely noisy variance proxy, and regressing one noisy log proxy on another attenuates the coefficient. Measured directly: the lag-1 autocorrelation of log daily variance for SPY is +0.136 under cc versus +0.653 under Garman-Klass. The gate was measuring proxy noise, not persistence. This is the documented reason HAR is built on range or intraday RV rather than squared daily returns.
specification_iteration.guard_against_fitting_the_gate: the replacement estimator was NOT chosen because it passes: it is the one selected in step 1 by out-of-sample QLIKE, a criterion computed before the gate and unrelated to it. The gate is reported for all four estimators, including the one that fails.

calibration_short_term_reversal.note: gate is sign only; the horizon-monotonicity requirement was dropped in M1 -- it is a single-stock result resting on bid-ask bounce and does not transfer to ETFs
